headline: Committee discusses plans for Veterans Day service
summary: Members approved the previous meeting's minutes as submitted. The committee discussed moving the Veterans Day service to a different location or working with the Senior Center to increase attendance. They also discussed speaker and music options for the event.
plain_text:
VETERAN’S MEMORIAL COMMITTEE 
 
Meeting of the Veterans Memorial Committee was held on September 21, 2026 at Wallingford Town Hall 
Room 220. Chairman Ruth Palmer called the meeting to order at 1900. There were 9 members present.  
 
Minutes for previous meeting approved as submitted. 
 
This meeting is to begin planning Veterans Day service. 
 
Secretary asked if perhaps we could go to a different location, or work with Senior Center to bolster 
attendance; discussion held. 
 
Discussion also held regarding speaker and music. 
 
Next meeting is October 5, 2026 at 1900 at Wallingford Town Hall Room 220.  
 
Meeting adjourned at 1939 after a moment of silence for departed members. 
 
 
Respectfully submitted, 
 
 
Elise M. Gallup 
Secretary
